metadata.description: Portable agent plugins for working with MicroPython.

plugins.name: mpremote
plugins.description: Work with attached MicroPython boards using mpremote on Windows, Linux, WSL2, and Docker.

plugins.name: mpflash
plugins.description: Identify boards, download firmware, and flash MicroPython with mpflash on Windows, Linux, macOS, WSL2, and compatible containers.

plugins.name: mpbuild
plugins.description: Build custom MicroPython firmware with mpbuild containers on Linux, macOS, and WSL2, then hand off to mpflash for approved device flashing.
